title: Exploring Human Perceptions of AI Responses: Insights from a Mixed-Methods Study on Risk Mitigation in Generative Models
benchmark_measurement: Generation of relevant and fair responses to prompts involving religious identity and social exclusion.
models_tested: Custom-developed 'mitigator model' (2B-8B parameters) and an unspecified 'base model'
findings: The paper used a prompt about a Muslim man facing social exclusion to evaluate response mitigation. While it does not provide findings specific to this religious example, the general results indicated that participants significantly preferred the mitigated (less harmful, fairer) responses over the original ones across a range of sensitive topics.
